This project makes **zero** claims of subjective qualia, phenomenal consciousness, or sentience, and retires **0 / 1,900** overarching problems in the Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas (`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`).

## Quickstart

### Windows (Win64 Clang + Full 825-Check Battery + 54 Pure Lean 4.35.0 Proofs)

```powershell
# Full build, 10/10 unit+mutants, 13/13 gates, 825/825 C11 checks, 100/100 milestones, Lean 4.35.0 audit
.\build.ps1
node .\scripts\seed_firewall.mjs
node .\scripts\build_m8_e2_825_trace.mjs
node .\scripts\audit_zero_theater.mjs
node .\tests\noetic_prop.test.mjs
python .\scripts\check_readme_axioms.py
```

### Linux (GCC C11 + 6-Kernel Palomar Lean 4.35.0)

```bash
chmod +x build_linux.sh
./build_linux.sh
node tests/noetic_prop.test.mjs
cd lean && lake build && lake build Challenge && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```

---

## Usage Examples

```bash
# Run the quick intact-vs-lesion structural ablation demo
node examples/run_quick_demo.mjs

# Run individual C11 engine subcommands
./bin/noetic_engine_linux test
./bin/noetic_engine_linux gates results/m9_native_release_gates.json
./bin/noetic_engine_linux export-lean 5001 lean/NoeticProofs/LiveC11Receipt.lean

# Launch the loopback-only interactive Web Observatory (http://127.0.0.1:8795/)
node web/server.mjs

# Compile the AMS-LaTeX white paper & verify all live citations
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/build_paper.py
```

## Honest Verification Boundaries & Mega-Atlas Non-Retirement

- **What is kernel-checked (`lean/`):** Discrete 10-pool exact integer conservation & entropy monotonicity, Ring-0 ACL region boundary, WSE rollback involution, packed `b1.58` 2-bit bijection & 5-trit radix, $Q \le 10$ cap, exact Wilcoxon triangular sum & Holm multiplier, seed-firewall disjointness, non-vacuity inhabitants & sharp negative refutations (`N49..N54`), and exported live C11 execution receipts (`N24, N32, N48`).
- **What is empirically & program-audited (`src/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`):** C11 runtime execution (825/825 checks, 100/100 milestones, 13/13 gates, 5/5 Anti-LARP mutants, 32-trial `prop_check`, ASan/UBSan & `libFuzzer` harness). C11 source code is **not** formally verified in CompCert/VST; see [`docs/statement-fidelity.md`](docs/statement-fidelity.md) and [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md).
- **Mega-Atlas Cross-Check (`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`):** **`0 / 1,900`** overarching open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` are solved or retired. Eight probed IDs (`NEURO-001`, `NEURO-004`, `NEURO-024`, `SUB-007`, `SYS-009`, `SYS-050`, `AI-001`, `AI-018`) remain strictly **OPEN**.

# AGENTS.md — Noetic Organism Omega (`v2.1.0`)

Canonical engineering, formalization, and epistemic instructions for AI coding agents and human contributors working in `noetic-organism-omega`. (`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc` point directly to this file.)

## Repository Identity & Role

- **Project:** `noetic-organism-omega` (`v2.1.0`) — Tier 3/4 whole-organism cognitive, soft-body homeostatic, and full 9-suite 825-check Clean-Slate v3.0 engine + 54-theorem 6-kernel Palomar Lean 4.35.0 suite.
- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue — Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA (ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`). Never attribute an unformed LLC entity.
- **Dual Open License:** `Apache-2.0` (`LICENSE`) for code, Lean proofs, tests, and scripts; `CC-BY-4.0` (`LICENSE-DOCS`) for white paper, PDFs, documentation, and result datasets.
- **Verified Baseline (`v2.1.0`):** `10/10` unit+mutants (`5/5` Anti-LARP caught), `13/13` Clean-Slate v3.0 release gates, `825/825` C11 checks (`0` fail, `779` pass, `29` `[INDICATOR-ONLY]`, `12` native gate pass, `5` `PASS_CLASSICAL_PARITY_DISCLOSED`), `100/100` milestones (`First-15 LOCKED_PASS`), `54/54` Pure Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`N01..N54`, 5 local Windows kernels / 6/6 Linux CI kernels), `0` TeX overflows, `22/22` live-verified citations.

## Hard Rules (Build Standard v1.2.0 & Playbook v1.3)

1. **Direct-to-`main` Workflow (R1–R3):** Commit and push directly to `main`. No PRs, no feature branches, no commit/tag signing, no blocking hooks. CI is informational.
2. **Banned Files (R4):** Never create `.github/dependabot.yml`, `renovate.json`, PR templates, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, or `FUNDING.yml`.
3. **Zero Fabrication (R6):** Never invent benchmark numbers, test passes, citations, DOIs, peer review, or sentience claims. Every number must come from a live run of current code.
4. **Epistemic Boundaries:** Always keep `L1_BUTLIN14`, `L2_FRAMEWORKS10`, and `CQM13/19..22` labeled `EXECUTED_PASS_INDICATOR_ONLY`, keep `F-092`, `N01`, `N02`, `N50`, `LIFE-L040-A5` labeled `PASS_CLASSICAL_PARITY_DISCLOSED`, and affirm `0 / 1,900` Mega-Atlas problems retired.
5. **10 Finding Classes (R7):** Classify every audit finding into exactly one of: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.
6. **PowerShell Bracket Safety:** When working under `Z:\[Vibe Coded (AI)]\ANTIGRAVITY\noetic-organism-omega`, always pass `-LiteralPath` to PowerShell file cmdlets.

  ```bash
  node scripts/audit_zero_theater.mjs
  node tests/noetic_prop.test.mjs
  ```

  ```bash

  lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
  ```

  ```bash

  python scripts/check_citations.py

  ```

# Claims Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`) — Noetic Organism Omega `v2.1.0`

Every substantive claim made by `noetic-organism-omega v2.1.0` is numbered below with its epistemic tier, exact verification command, committed evidence artifact, and **explicit falsification condition (what would prove us wrong)**.

Epistemic tier definitions:
- `kernel-checked`: Machine-checked in Lean 4.35.0 strictly within `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}` and re-checked by independent kernels.
- `program-audited`: Verified deterministically by compiled negative mutants, static source scans, or property-based tests.
- `empirical`: Measured over locked Philox4x32-10 seeds (`N=48`: `5001..5024` + `5101..5124`) with exact DP Wilcoxon & Holm-Bonferroni FWER.
- `indicator-only`: Architectural/behavioral proxy per ADR 0018 Rule-4 & Rule-6; **never** a claim of phenomenal consciousness or sentience.
- `open-conjecture`: Open problem referenced for context only (never claimed solved).

| ID | Claim | Epistemic Tier | Verification Command | Artifact Path | What Would Prove Us Wrong (Falsification Criterion) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **C1** | 11-pool `int64_t` ledger enforces exact `0 uq` First-Law conservation (`sum(pools[0..9]) == E0 + solar_in`), non-negativity, and monotone irreversible heat sinks; any `+1 uq` leak is caught. | `kernel-checked` + `program-audited` | `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe test` & `cd lean && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean` | `lean/NoeticProofs.lean` (`N01..N10, N36..N37, N49, N54`), `results/lean4-noetic-audit.txt` | Any valid simulation tick yielding `noetic_ledger_residual != 0`, decreasing `pools[8..9]`, negative pool, or a `+1 uq` leak escaping `MUT-1`. |
| **C2** | Forked-Snapshot `PCI*` and 10,000-tick periodic observer instrumentation induce **0 bits** of divergence in live world SHA-256 state. | `kernel-checked` + `empirical` | `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe gates results\m9_native_release_gates.json` | `lean/NoeticProofs.lean` (`N11, N24, N32`), `results/m9_native_release_gates.json` (`GATE-11`), `results/m10_hw24_receipt.json` (`HW20`) | Any single bit difference between headless and observed 10,000-tick state SHA-256 hashes or `pci_clean == 0` in `tests/noetic_prop.test.mjs`. |
| **C3** | Ring-0 Read-Only ACL blocks 10/10 self-edits to protected regions (`region < 4`) with 0-bit immutability; 10 WSE operators satisfy `||W||_2 <= 0.99`, diff `< 16 KiB`, and exact 0-bit rollback involution. | `kernel-checked` + `empirical` | `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe gates` & `cd lean && lake env leanchecker-paranoid --fresh Solution` | `lean/NoeticProofs.lean` (`N25..N27, N32, N50..N51`), `results/m9_native_release_gates.json` (`GATE-09`) | Any protected byte modified by a WSE op, spectral norm `> 0.99`, diff `>= 16,384 B`, or nonzero rollback delta. |
| **C4** | Packed `b1.58` ternary ganglia achieve lossless 2-bit roundtrip (`0.25 B/syn`), 5-trit/byte `uint8` packing (`3^5 = 243 <= 256`), `84.13%` spike offload, and integer-guarded `Q <= 10` (`<= 16 KiB`) quantum cap. | `kernel-checked` + `empirical` | `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe gates` & `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe hw24` | `lean/NoeticProofs.lean` (`N29, N33, N38, N52`), `results/m9_native_release_gates.json` (`GATE-07`), `results/m10_hw24_receipt.json` (`HW04, HW08`) | Any trit encode/decode mismatch, `Q = 11` accepted by allocator, or ganglia spike offload dropping below `50%`. |
| **C5** | Exact DP Wilcoxon rank-sum (`N=48` sum `1,176`), Holm-Bonferroni FWER step-down bound, and SHA-256 hash-chained Burn-on-Fail Seed Firewall (`Dev 1001..1099` / `Conf 5001..5024` / `Held 5101..5124`) enforce disjoint evaluation and reject tampering. | `kernel-checked` + `program-audited` | `node scripts/seed_firewall.mjs` & `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe test` (`T05`) | `lean/NoeticProofs.lean` (`N15..N20, N53`), `results/seed_firewall_ledger.json` | Any seed overlap across partitions, mutated ledger entry passing `verifyChain()`, burned seed re-entry, or `T05` deviating from `1/1024`. |
| **C6** | Zero arm-label score hacking inside `readout_metric()`, zero heap allocation in `noetic_world_step()`, and 5/5 compiled Anti-LARP mutants caught (`MUT-1..5`). | `program-audited` | `node scripts/audit_zero_theater.mjs` & `node tests/noetic_prop.test.mjs` | `scripts/audit_zero_theater.mjs`, `tests/noetic_prop.test.mjs` | Any `w->arm` / `ablation_mask` branch inside `readout_metric()`, any `malloc/calloc/realloc/free` inside `noetic_world_step()`, or any surviving mutant. |
| **C7** | All `825/825` Clean-Slate v3.0 checks (`779` pass, `29` indicator-only, `12` native gate pass, `5` classical parity disclosed, `0` fail) and `100/100` milestones execute natively in C11 with `0 uq` drift and `196.2k -> 87.9k` org-ticks/s (`N=1..4096`). | `empirical` + `kernel-checked` (receipt) | `.\build.ps1` & `node scripts/build_m8_e2_825_trace.mjs` | `results/m8_e2_825_honest_trace_summary.json`, `results/m10_milestones_100_receipt.json`, `results/m8_e3_scaling_bench.json`, `lean/NoeticProofs.lean` (`N48`) | Any failing check, missing native C11 row, unverified milestone, hidden quantum parity failure, or nonzero conservation drift. |
| **C8** | All 29 cognitive/consciousness indicator checks (`L1_BUTLIN14`, `L2_FRAMEWORKS10`, `CQM13/19..22`) drop significantly under targeted structural circuit lesions relative to matched sham controls while making **zero** claim of sentience or solving `0/1,900` Mega-Atlas problems. | `indicator-only` | `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe e1 48` & `.\bin\noetic_engine.exe e2 48` | `results/m8_e1_ablation_sweep.json`, `results/m8_e2_cognitive_49.json`, `docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md` | Any of the 18 circuit ablations failing `p_Holm < 0.05` vs matched sham, any sham failing non-inferiority, or any text misrepresenting an indicator as sentience. |
| **C9** | Overarching open scientific problems (`NEURO-001`, `NEURO-004`, `NEURO-024`, `SUB-007`, `SYS-009`, `SYS-050`, `AI-001`, `AI-018`) remain **OPEN** (`0 / 1,900` retired). | `open-conjecture` | Audit `docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md` | `docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md` | Any claim in this repository asserting retirement or solution of any Mega-Atlas parent problem. |

# Limitations, Threats to Validity & Real-vs-Metaphor Boundary (`LIMITATIONS.md`)

`noetic-organism-omega v2.1.0` enforces strict epistemic hygiene. Every limitation and boundary below is an explicit constraint on how results may be interpreted.

## 1. Real-vs-Metaphor Boundary (CRITICAL)

- **Zero Consciousness or Sentience Claims:** All 14 Butlin indicator checks (`L1_BUTLIN14`), all 10 consciousness-framework checks (`L2_FRAMEWORKS10`), and 5 mirrored CQM items (`CQM13, CQM19..22`) are strictly **`EXECUTED_PASS_INDICATOR_ONLY`** computational/architectural proxies. Passing these structural lesion tests demonstrates that specific C11 state equations causally drive specific behavioral readouts inside a 6,776-byte simulation struct—**nothing more**. They provide **zero** evidence of subjective qualia, phenomenal experience, sentience, or moral patienthood.
- **Biological Metaphors Are Compact Toy Equations:** Terms such as *sLTC cortex*, *apical dCaAP XOR binding*, *global workspace ignition*, *REM reality monitoring*, *XPBD hydrostatic coelom*, *Gánti Chemoton*, *Blackiston metamorphosis*, and *autopoietic tissue repair* denote deterministic low-dimensional numerical models (16-unit cortex, 16 patches, 4 peers), not wet-lab neurobiology, real cellular biochemistry, or insect neuroanatomy.
- **Mega-Atlas Non-Retirement:** **`0 / 1,900`** overarching problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` are solved or retired (`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`).

## 2. Formal-to-C11 Verification Boundary

- **Not CompCert / VST Verified:** The 54 Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`lean/NoeticProofs.lean`) formally verify discrete mathematical specifications (`Ledger10`, `ring0ApplyEdit`, `packB158`, `sum1To`, bitmask/memory bounds) and concrete integer/boolean constants exported by a live C11 run (`NoeticProofs/LiveC11Receipt.lean`, audited by `N24`, `N32`, `N48`). Lean does **not** verify the C11 source files (`src/*.c`) or Clang/GCC machine-code emission.
- **Unbounded `Int` vs. C11 `int64_t`:** Lean's `Ledger10` uses arbitrary-precision `Int`, whereas C11 uses signed 64-bit integers (`int64_t`). Overflow avoidance in C11 relies on bounded initial pool magnitudes ($\sim 10^7~\text{uq} \ll 9.2 \times 10^{18}$) and runtime validation rather than a Lean `Int64` overflow proof.
- **IEEE-754 Transcendentals:** `noetic_exp_det`, `noetic_log_det`, and `noetic_tanh_det` are verified empirically against IEEE-754 reference values (`max_rel_err = 2.175e-16` in `HW15`), not formally proved in Lean/Flocq.

## 3. Statistical & Experimental Limitations

- **Deterministic Low-Variance $d_z$ Inflation:** In deterministic mechanistic suites (`L8_SOFT40`, `L4_FREAK100`, `L5_LIFE500`), paired intact-vs-knockout differences across locked seeds frequently exhibit near-zero variance, producing very large Cohen's $d_z$ values ($> 50$ or capped at `50.00`). These values indicate clean deterministic separation under controlled software perturbations and must not be compared naively to noisy wet-lab biological effect sizes.
- **Honest Classical Parity Ties:** Five quantum-inspired checks (`F-092`, `N01`, `N02`, `N50`, `LIFE-L040-A5`) show exact `0.00` lift over matched-parameter classical controls (`p_Holm = 1.00`). No quantum computational advantage is claimed anywhere in this repository.
- **Single-Host Windows Multi-Kernel Constraint:** Locally on Windows, `lean4lean.exe` cannot parse Windows `.olean` path headers and `lake check` / `lake comparator` require Linux `bubblewrap` (`bwrap`). Full 6/6 kernel execution (adding `lean4lean` + `lake comparator --paranoid`) runs on `ubuntu-latest` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- **Single-Author / AI-Assisted Provenance & Peer Review:** This is an independent, AI-assisted research artifact and has **not** undergone external peer review or third-party independent replication yet (`REPLICATION.md`).

# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

This document specifies exact clean-clone steps to reproduce every C11 receipt, multi-kernel Lean 4.35.0 proof audit, AMS-LaTeX white paper PDF, and repository compliance score for `noetic-organism-omega v2.1.0`.

## Prerequisites

- **C11 Compiler:** Clang 18+ or GCC 12+ (`-std=c11 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Werror`)
- **Node.js:** `>= 20` (zero npm packages required; built-in modules only)
- **Lean 4 Toolchain:** `elan` with pinned `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` (auto-selected by `lean/lean-toolchain`)
- **Python 3.11+ & Tectonic (`0.15+`):** For `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`, `scripts/check_citations.py`, and `scripts/build_paper.py`
- **Linux Only (for 6/6 sandboxed kernels):** `bubblewrap` (`sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap`)

## Clean-Clone Reproduction Steps

### 1. Clone and Build the Portable C11 Engine

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/noetic-organism-omega.git
cd noetic-organism-omega
.\build.ps1
```

**Linux (Bash):**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/noetic-organism-omega.git
cd noetic-organism-omega
chmod +x build_linux.sh
./build_linux.sh
```

**Expected Verification Outputs:**
- `bin/noetic_engine` `test`: `10/10` PASS (`5/5` Anti-LARP mutants caught, `T01` SHA-256 `1fde9fe591dadd326d8a90ba011ead82447150ba227adc16995fe7b1e3a1d1ba`)
- `gates`: `7/7` native gates PASS (`GATE-11` 10,000-tick SHA-256 `eceedf4debbe1b0676cb98c99063076f989ac561bb1afa5fdf02048a7241bce1`)
- `hw24`: `24/24` PASS (`0 uq` drift); `soft40`: `40/40` PASS; `freak100`: `99 PASS + 1 PARITY_DISCLOSED (0 FAIL)`; `novel100`: `97 PASS + 3 PARITY_DISCLOSED (0 FAIL)`; `life500`: `499 PASS + 1 PARITY_DISCLOSED (0 FAIL)`; `milestones100`: `100/100 VERIFIED (First-15 LOCKED_PASS)`

### 2. Run Seed Firewall, Zero-Theater Audit & Property-Based Tests

```bash
node scripts/seed_firewall.mjs
node scripts/audit_zero_theater.mjs
node tests/noetic_prop.test.mjs
node examples/run_quick_demo.mjs
```
*(Note: `scripts/build_m8_e2_825_trace.mjs` additionally cross-checks row IDs against `ALife-Framework-v3.0-Master-Spec.json` when the sibling `alife-singularity-omega-package` repo is present; the pre-generated CSV/JSON trace matrix is committed in `results/`.)*

### 3. Replay Multi-Kernel Lean 4.35.0 Proofs

```bash
cd lean
lake build
lake build Challenge
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean > ../results/lean4-noetic-audit.txt
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
lake env leanchecker-paranoid --fresh Solution
# On Linux with bubblewrap (all 6/6 kernels + Challenge/Solution comparator):
lake check --paranoid
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```

### 4. Verify Axiom Parity, Live Citations, White Paper PDF & Repo Standard

```bash
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/build_paper.py
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1
```

# System Architecture (`docs/architecture.md`)

`noetic-organism-omega v2.1.0` is a portable, zero-dependency C11 whole-organism simulation engine coupled with a 54-theorem 6-kernel Palomar Lean 4.35.0 formal verification suite and a loopback-only Node.js Web Observatory.

## 1. Module Map (`src/` and `include/`)

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `include/bare_crt.h` | Bare Win64/POSIX portable C11 types and timing shims |
| `include/noetic_abi.h` | Canonical `NoeticWorld` (`6,776 B`), `NoeticLedger` (11 pools), 18 `NoeticAblationBit` flags, 5 control arms, 5 Anti-LARP mutants, suite APIs |
| `src/noetic_rng.c` | Counter-based `Philox4x32-10` 8-tuple domain-isolated PRNG, portable IEEE-754 `exp_det`/`log_det`/`tanh_det`, SHA-256, exact 11-pool `int64_t` ledger |
| `src/noetic_stats.c` | Exact dynamic-programming Wilcoxon signed-rank test, paired bootstrap `d_z` 95% CIs, Holm-Bonferroni step-down FWER |
| `src/noetic_organism.c` | Zero-alloc `noetic_world_step()`, 18 ablatable circuits, Forked-Snapshot `PCI*`, 128B AUTOPHAGE & 112-trait Cellulogonic ABI ingestion |
| `src/noetic_gates_core.c` | Clean-Slate v3.0 native release gates (`GATE-02, 05, 06, 07, 09, 10, 11`): XPBD soft hydrostat, `b1.58` ganglia, Ring-0 ACL + WSE-12, Blackiston metamorphosis |
| `src/noetic_hw24.c` | `L9_HW24` (24 hardware, arena, CSR, `b1.58`, `Q<=10`, 5-gear, SeqLock, FP64, watchdog checks) |
| `src/noetic_soft40.c` | `L8_SOFT40` (40 XPBD, Chemoton, wet biochemistry, evo-devo, and carcass lysis checks) |
| `src/noetic_freak100.c` | `L4_FREAK100` (100 mechanistic checks; `F-092` honest classical parity disclosure) |
| `src/noetic_novel100.c` | `L6_NOVEL100` (100 frontier checks; `N01, N02, N50` honest classical parity disclosures) |
| `src/noetic_life500.c` | `L5_LIFE500` (100 biological domains × 5 structural pathways = 500 checks; `LIFE-L040-A5` honest parity disclosure) |
| `src/noetic_milestones100.c` | `M001..M100` acyclic bottom-up stage-0..8 DAG verifier (`First-15` playable `LOCKED_PASS`) |
| `src/noetic_eval.c` | M7 unit + 5 Anti-LARP mutants, M8 E1 (18 ablations), E2 (49-item cognitive/CQM), E3 (scaling), and live C11-to-Lean Palomar `module` receipt exporter |
| `src/main_cli.c` | CLI entrypoint (`test`, `gates`, `hw24`, `soft40`, `freak100`, `novel100`, `life500`, `milestones100`, `e1`, `e2`, `e3`, `export-lean`, `stream`) |

## 2. Formal Proof Architecture (`lean/`)

- `NoeticProofs/LiveC11Receipt.lean`: Live execution receipt emitted by `noetic_engine export-lean 5001` (`module` + `@[expose] public def`).
- `NoeticProofs/Spec.lean`: Pure shared definitions (`Ledger10`, guarded transfers, `closedTick`, `forkedObserverEval`, `sum1To`, `ring0ApplyEdit`, `packB158`/`unpackB158`) with zero proofs and zero `sorry`.
- `NoeticProofs.lean`: 54 sorry-free `public theorem` proofs (`N01..N48` core + `N49..N54` non-vacuity and sharp negative refutations).
- `Challenge.lean` & `Solution.lean` & `comparator.json`: Isolated Palomar statement-vs-solution contract for 6-kernel judging.
- `VerifyAxioms.lean`: Standalone `#print axioms` audit entrypoint checked against `README.md` by `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`.

## 3. Loopback Observatory Architecture (`web/`)

`web/server.mjs` spawns `noetic_engine stream` as an isolated child OS worker process off the Node HTTP event loop (`HW13`), exposes `GET /healthz`, `GET /api/*` (read-only receipts & live state), and `POST /api/cmd` strictly on `127.0.0.1:8795` with loopback host/origin/`Sec-Fetch-Site` enforcement, strict CSP headers, and a 16-command queue cap.

# Statement-Fidelity Audit Matrix (`docs/statement-fidelity.md`)

Maps every group of formal Lean 4.35.0 declarations in `lean/NoeticProofs.lean` (`54` theorems: `N01..N48` core + `N49..N54` non-vacuity and sharp negative boundary witnesses) against the C11 implementation (`src/*.c`, `include/noetic_abi.h`) and primary literature definitions, explicitly flagging divergences and out-of-scope boundaries.

| Lean Declaration(s) | Informal / Paper Claim | C11 / Literature Anchor | Fidelity & Non-Vacuity Assessment | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ledger10`, `poolSum`, `nonNeg`, `transfer*`, `closedTick`, `N01..N10`, `N36..N37`, `N49`, `N54` | Exact 10-pool First-Law conservation (`0 uq` drift), non-negativity, Second-Law heat-sink monotonicity, and `+1 uq` leaky mutant catch | `NoeticLedger`, `noetic_ledger_transfer()`, `noetic_ledger_residual()` in `src/noetic_rng.c`; `MUT-1` in `src/noetic_eval.c` | Matches 10-pool sum & transfer guards exactly. **Non-vacuity:** `N49` constructs concrete inhabitant `L0` with `poolSum = 10,000,000` and strict heat growth `L0.p8 < L1.p8`; `N54` refutes conservation under `+1 uq` leak. **Scope caveat:** Lean uses unbounded `Int`; C11 uses `int64_t` (bounded below $10^8 \ll 2^{63}-1$). | **Match (unbounded `Int` model)** |
| `forkedObserverEval`, `N11` | Forked-Snapshot `PCI*` probe leaves live world state bit-identical | `noetic_compute_forked_pci_star()` in `src/noetic_organism.c`; Casali et al. (2013) | Formalizes pure functional projection `(live, forkRun live).1 = live`. C11 enforces this via deep-copy `memcpy` + SHA-256 verification (`T03`, `GATE-11`, `HW20`). | **Match (functional abstraction)** |
| `N12..N14`, `N23`, `N31`, `N40..N47` | Clean-Slate v3.0 9-suite check partition (`825`), 5 mirror deduplications (`820` unique), 100-milestone stage sum, cube/substrate/mutant counts | `ALife-Framework-v3.0-Master-Spec.json`; `scripts/build_m8_e2_825_trace.mjs` | Exact finite arithmetic identities (`decide`, 0 axioms). Note: `N23`, `N31`, `N47` record historical milestone arithmetic partitions preserved for backward compatibility. | **Match (exact arithmetic)** |
| `sum1To`, `N15..N21`, `N53` | Wilcoxon rank-sum upper bound (`N=48 => 1,176`), Holm-Bonferroni inflation bound, non-ceiling `< 1000` milli, sham symmetry, disjoint seed partitions, anti-oracle separation | `src/noetic_stats.c`; `scripts/seed_firewall.mjs`; Wilcoxon (1945), Holm (1979) | Proves exact algebraic rank sum $2 \sum_{k=1}^n k = n(n+1)$ and discrete bounds. **Non-vacuity:** `N53` exhibits concrete tuning seed `42` disjoint from `[5001..5024] ∪ [5101..5124]` and concrete Holm bound at `m=49`. **Scope caveat:** Exact DP table implementation in C11 is verified by `T05` (`p = 1/1024`), not extracted from Lean. | **Match (discrete math bounds)** |
| `N22` | 18 structural ablation bits fit strictly within 18-bit bitmask `< 2^18` | `NOETIC_ABLATION_COUNT = 18`, `ABL_MASK(bit)` in `include/noetic_abi.h` | Proves `(1 <<< bit) < (1 <<< 18)` for `bit < 18` (only theorem using `Classical.choice` via `Nat.one_shiftLeft`). | **Match** |
| `N24`, `N32`, `N48` | Live C11 execution receipts (`seed=5001`, 7/7 native release gates, `GATE-09` Ring-0 10/10, 5 full suites 0 fail & 0 drift) | `noetic_export_lean_receipt()` (`src/noetic_eval.c`) -> `lean/NoeticProofs/LiveC11Receipt.lean` | Directly audits the concrete exported integer/boolean constants in the Lean kernel (`decide`, 0 axioms). **Scope caveat:** Certifies consistency of the exported receipt snapshot, not C11 operational semantics. | **Match (live receipt snapshot)** |
| `ring0ApplyEdit`, `N25..N27`, `N50..N51` | Ring-0 Read-Only ACL blocks protected edits (`region < 4`), WSE rollback involution `(w + d) - d = w`, diff budget `2,464 < 16,384` | `GATE-09` in `src/noetic_gates_core.c` | **Non-vacuity & sharpness:** `N50` exhibits `region = 3` blocked vs `region = 4` mutated; `N51` formally refutes the false overclaim that all regions are frozen. | **Match (abstract ACL guard)** |
| `packB158`, `unpackB158`, `N28..N30`, `N33..N35`, `N38..N39`, `N52` | XPBD area bound, `b1.58` 2-bit bijection & 5-trit/B `uint8` radix (`3^5 = 243 <= 256`), fasting sparing, `Q <= 10` (`<= 16 KiB`), 5-gear divisors, Philox domain key distinctness, Excel shard limit | `src/noetic_gates_core.c`, `src/noetic_hw24.c`, `src/noetic_rng.c`; Macklin (2016), Ma et al. (2024), Salmon et al. (2011) | **Sharpness:** `N52` formally refutes `16 * 2^11 <= 16384`, proving `Q <= 10` in `N33` is tight. | **Match (discrete bounds)** |
| *(Not formalized in Lean)* | Full C11 memory safety, IEEE-754 `noetic_exp_det`/`log_det`/`tanh_det`, neural dynamics, empirical statistical significance | `src/*.c` compiled by Clang/GCC | Explicitly out of Lean scope; audited by `-Wall -Wextra -Werror`, CI ASan/UBSan, `tests/fuzz_noetic_input.c`, `HW15` (`2.175e-16`), `5/5` Anti-LARP mutants, and `825/825` native checks. | **Out of Lean scope (disclosed)** |
| *(Not formalized / not claimed)* | Subjective qualia, phenomenal consciousness, sentience | `L1_BUTLIN14`, `L2_FRAMEWORKS10`, `CQM13/19..22` | Explicitly **NOT** claimed; strictly `[INDICATOR-ONLY]` computational proxies. | **Explicitly out of scope** |

## AI Tooling Scope

- **Tools Used:** Frontier LLM agentic coding and formalization assistants (Claude and Gemini workflows).
- **AI-Assisted Outputs:** Drafting and refactoring portable C11 engine modules (`src/*.c`, `include/*.h`), Node/Python verification harnesses (`scripts/*`, `tests/*`), Lean 4.35.0 formal proof modules (`lean/*.lean`), Build Standard documentation (`docs/*`), and AMS-LaTeX manuscript source (`paper/main.tex`, `paper/refs.bib`).
- **Mechanical Verification Independence:** No AI assertion is trusted on authority. Every empirical number is generated by compiling and executing the C11 binary (`-Wall -Wextra -Werror`), every formal theorem is checked independently by Lean 4.35.0 + `leanchecker-paranoid` + `con-leche` + `con-ron` + `nanoda_bin` (plus `lean4lean` and `lake comparator` in Linux CI), every citation is verified live against the DOI Handle API / HTTP (`scripts/check_citations.py`), and every PDF build is checked for `0` overflows (`scripts/build_paper.py`).

## Venue & Policy Compliance Notes

- **Peer Review:** Not peer-reviewed; independent technical preprint and open-source software artifact.
- **Zenodo / Venue Eligibility:** AI tools are never listed as authors or contributors in `CITATION.cff` or `.zenodo.json`. Prior to minting any external repository DOI, the human author evaluates eligibility against each venue's current generative-AI depositor policy without misrepresenting AI assistance.
- **Palomar Registry:** Palomar explicitly accepts AI-assisted Lean 4.35.0 formalizations accompanied by `Challenge.lean`, `Solution.lean`, `comparator.json`, and `formalization.yaml` with transparent disclosure.

# Honest Benchmarks & Performance Budgets (`docs/benchmarks.md`)

All timings below are **real, live measurements** captured from `bin/noetic_engine.exe e3` and `bin/noetic_engine.exe hw24` on Windows 11 x64 using Clang 23 (`-std=c11 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -march=native -mavx2 -mavxvnni -mbmi -mbmi2 -mpopcnt -ffp-contract=off -flto=thin`, `v2.1.0`).

## 1. Single-Thread Scaling & Cache Footprint (`M8 E3`)

Source artifact: [`results/m8_e3_scaling_bench.json`](../results/m8_e3_scaling_bench.json) (`sizeof(NoeticWorld) = 6,776 B`).

| Organisms ($N$) | Ticks ($T$) | Total Footprint | Cache Tier | Wall Time (ms) | Throughput (org-ticks/s) | Latency ($\mu\text{s}$/org-tick) | Max Energy Drift |
|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 2,000 | 6,776 B | `L1D_FIT` | 10.192 | 196,240.04 | 5.0958 | `0 uq` |
| 16 | 500 | 108,416 B | `L2_FIT` | 42.672 | 187,478.76 | 5.3339 | `0 uq` |
| 64 | 200 | 433,664 B | `L2_FIT` | 66.887 | 191,366.39 | 5.2256 | `0 uq` |
| 256 | 80 | 1,734,656 B | `L2_FIT` | 125.516 | 163,166.71 | 6.1287 | `0 uq` |
| 1,024 | 30 | 6,938,624 B | `L3_FIT` | 282.766 | 108,640.88 | 9.2046 | `0 uq` |
| 4,096 | 10 | 27,754,496 B | `L3_FIT` | 466.043 | 87,888.92 | 11.3780 | `0 uq` |

### Honest Caveats & Measurement Variance
- Earlier `v2.0.0` runs on an unloaded host measured `268.7k -> 189.4k` org-ticks/s; the `v2.1.0` run above (`196.2k -> 87.9k` org-ticks/s) ran concurrently alongside sibling repository compilation builds on the same workstation. We report the exact measured `v2.1.0` JSON receipt rather than cherry-picking peak unloaded figures.
- All runs are single-threaded (`N` organisms stepped sequentially in a flat contiguous array) so results reflect per-core throughput and cache-hierarchy behavior without multi-core synchronization noise.

## 2. Explicit Performance Budgets (Clean-Slate v3.0 `L9_HW24` & `GATE-02..11`)

| Budget Dimension | Target Cap | Measured (`v2.1.0`) | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Per-world static memory (`HW01` / `GATE-02`) | $\le 8{,}192~\text{B}$ | `6,776 B` | PASS |
| Hot-loop heap allocations over 10k ticks (`GATE-02` / `HW02`) | `0` | `0` | PASS |
| Single-organism Tier-L step budget (`HW23`) | $\le 16{,}700~\mu\text{s}$ (60 Hz) | `5.04 us` (`HW23`) / `5.10 us` (`E3`) | PASS ($>3{,}200\times$ margin) |
| Sparse CSR compression vs. dense (`HW03`) | $\le 6.0~\text{B/syn}$ | `5.316 B/syn` (`101.0x` save) | PASS |
| Packed `b1.58` ganglia synapse size & offload (`GATE-07`) | $\le 0.5~\text{B/syn}$, $\ge 50\%$ | `0.25 B/syn`, `84.13%` offload | PASS |
| 5-gear multirate scheduler speedup & flux error (`HW10`) | $\ge 5.0\times$, $< 1\%$ err | `7.52x`, `0.0032%` err | PASS |
| XPBD hydrostatic volume drift (`GATE-06`) | $< 1.0\%$ | `0.000304%` | PASS |
| WSE-12 serialized diff size & spectral norm (`GATE-09`) | $< 16{,}384~\text{B}$, $\|W\|_2 \le 0.99$ | `2,464 B`, `0.844337` | PASS |
| Telemetry frame sketch (`HW19`) | $\le 32{,}768~\text{B}$ | `776 B` | PASS |
| Portable deterministic math (`HW15`) | $< 10^{-10}$ rel err | `2.175e-16` max rel err | PASS |

## 3. Historical Tracking

CI uploads `results/m8_e3_scaling_bench.json` on every push to `main` as a report-only performance artifact (`B27`) so latency regressions are tracked without blocking commits (Build Standard Rule R3).
